projects.name: Ellendale 100 MW HPC facility
projects.quote: During the prior fiscal year, the Company broke ground on its first 100 MW HPC facility in Ellendale, North Dakota.

projects.name: Ellendale HPC Campus
projects.quote: Applied Digital continues negotiations with multiple US-based hyperscalers to lease up to 400 MW of capacity, inclusive of the Ellendale HPC data center under construction and two forthcoming buildings at the Ellendale Campus.

projects.name: Jamestown, N.D. 106 MW data center
projects.quote: As of February 28, 2025, the Company’s 106 MW facility in Jamestown, N.D., and 180 MW facility in Ellendale, N.D., are operating at full capacity.
